title.zh-CN: 短暂记忆异常后出现便血 · 38岁女性
title.en: Transient memory disturbance followed by bloody stools · 38-year-old female

summary.zh-CN: 围绕短暂记忆异常后出现便血，比较现有证据、不同解释与下一步处理。
summary.en: Review the evidence, competing explanations and next steps for transient memory disturbance followed by bloody stools.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 通过两年病史重构慢性肠道病程。
learningOutcomes.en: Reconstruct chronic bowel disease from a two-year history.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 结合内镜与病理评估肿瘤及炎症。
learningOutcomes.en: Integrate endoscopy/pathology in inflammatory and malignant differentials.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别持续出血的临床优先级。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise the priority of ongoing bleeding.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 区分相关肠外表现与确证脑血管炎。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish a possible extraintestinal association from proven cerebral vasculitis.

text.zh-CN: 升结肠和直肠壁增厚；肠镜约 30 cm 处不规则环状隆起，远端弥漫浅溃疡、糜烂及充血。
text.en: Thickened ascending colon/rectum; irregular circumferential elevation around 30 cm and diffuse distal shallow ulcers, erosions and erythema.

text.zh-CN: 严重急慢性炎症，未见明确隐窝脓肿或肿瘤细胞，免疫组化不支持淋巴瘤。
text.en: Severe acute/chronic inflammation without definite crypt abscesses or tumour cells; immunostains did not support lymphoma.

text.zh-CN: 反复粪便病原、艰难梭菌毒素及多项感染检查未见阳性；CRP 95.8 mg/L，Hb 由 129 降至 93 g/L。
text.en: Repeated stool pathogen/C. difficile toxin and several infection studies were negative; CRP 95.8 mg/L and Hb fell from 129 to 93 g/L.

name.zh-CN: 调阅 MRI 与脑脊液

zh-CN: 调阅 MRI 与脑脊液

text.zh-CN: 多部位白质点状异常信号；脑脊液压力 85 mmH₂O，常规、生化及所列病原学无异常。
text.en: Multifocal punctate white-matter abnormalities; CSF pressure 85 mmH₂O, with unremarkable routine/biochemical and listed microbiological studies.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 原报告使用泼尼松与硫唑嘌呤，后续 MRI 部分异常消退，肠镜黏膜改善。没有证明某一药物独立疗效，也未确证脑病变机制或 IBD 亚型。
text.en: Prednisone and azathioprine were used; later MRI lesions partly resolved and colonoscopy improved. Independent drug efficacy, CNS mechanism and a specific IBD subtype were not established.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 慢性复发便血支持炎症性肠病，伴短暂神经症状及白质异常，二者关系仍需谨慎表达。
conclusion.en: Chronic recurrent bleeding supports IBD with transient neurological symptoms and white-matter changes, whose relationship remains cautiously interpreted.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 追问长期病史改变急性症状的解释。
keyReasoning.en: Longer history changes interpretation of an acute presentation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 阴性筛查降低某些可能性，不是绝对排除全部感染。
keyReasoning.en: Negative studies reduce certain possibilities without excluding every infection.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 统一解释要保留机制与亚型边界。
keyReasoning.en: A unifying explanation must retain mechanistic and subtype limits.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.
